==Description==
The '''Developer 2''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] and therefore only appeared in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode.

The '''Developer 2''' had a high amount of health (higher than the [[Glitched Giant]] and [[Developer 1]]) and walked at a fast pace. The '''Developer 2''' was spawned from the [[Creator]] and did not appear naturally in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]].

==Appearance==
As with the other developer [[enemies]] in the game, the '''Developer 2''' was a re-textured version of a developer of the game, more specifically, [https://www.roblox.com/users/178596165/profile BiscuitTurtleKid] (now [https://www.roblox.com/users/178596165/profile LilDisquit]).

The '''Developer 2''' was faceless with reflective black skin. Its torso, legs, arms and head were completely reflective black. It had dark purple beautiful hair for beautiful people and dark antlers.

==Strategy==
*As with most enemies in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]], this enemy can be taken down with high DPS towers such as the {{Color|Golden}} [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]] or [[Ranger]].
**The [[Commander]] helps greatly in defeating this [[Enemies|enemy]].
*This enemy can be slowed down by the [[Electroshocker]], [[Sledger]], [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Freezer]].

==Trivia==
*This [[Enemies|enemy]] is similar to the [[Developer 1]] and [[Developer 3]].
**Like these enemies, the '''Developer 2''' did not appear naturally in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] and was instead spawned by the [[Creator]].
*This enemy's appearance is based on [https://www.roblox.com/users/178596165/profile LilDisquit], a retired developer of the game.
